numeric_differences.source: 编程旧预估不能统一判成“预测正确”。3650万专业开发者×30美元×12得到13.14B，是条件算术；把固定低价席位覆盖全部收入，已被按量收费、多档套餐和非专业用途打破。早期原稿自身还存在高价情景与“绝对上限”矛盾、$131B量纲错误；V1.5已撤回硬上限，本轮用历史原件补齐逐项裁决。公开产品指标仍不足以证明去重后的纯编程市场已超过13.14B，不能以修正模型冒充新市场实绩。依据及未来验证窗口见第五章。
numeric_differences.english: Earlier coding estimates cannot all be classified as “correct forecasts.” 36.50 million professional developers × USD 30 × 12 gives 13.14B: conditional arithmetic. Usage-based pricing, tiered plans and nonprofessional uses have invalidated the assumption that fixed low-price seats cover all revenue. The early original draft also contradicted its own high-price scenario with an “absolute ceiling” and contained a $131B unit-scale error; V1.5 withdrew the hard ceiling, and this review uses historical originals to complete the item-by-item judgments. Public product metrics still do not establish that the deduplicated pure-coding market has exceeded 13.14B; correcting a model cannot substitute for new realized market results. See Chapter 5 for the evidence and future validation windows.

numeric_differences.source: 一个可复算的敏感性例子：假设某批设备可折旧基础60亿美元、残值为零，直线法6年折旧每年10亿美元；若经济寿命只有3年，每年经济耗损相当于20亿美元。两种假设相差10亿美元税前费用，但这只是同一设备组、全年在用的演示。不能用全公司固定资产乘这个差额，也不能把它记成某家公司实际少提折旧。
numeric_differences.english: A reproducible sensitivity example: assume an equipment cohort with a USD 6 billion depreciable basis and zero residual value. Straight-line depreciation over 6 years is USD 1 billion annually; if economic life is only 3 years, annual economic consumption is equivalent to USD 2 billion. The assumptions differ by USD 1 billion of annual pretax expense, but this only illustrates the same equipment group operating for a full year. The difference cannot be multiplied across all company fixed assets or booked as actual underdepreciation at a particular company.

numeric_differences.source: Meta的Q2历史值仍有比较价值：经营现金31.862，现金固定资产购置30.116、租赁本金0.962，FCF为+0.784；Q3经营现金增加0.924，而上述两项付款合计增加3.828，单季FCF因而减少2.904至−2.120。Q3期末现金、现金等价物及有价证券合计约82.45，不能由单季转负推成即将出现支付危机；也不能把公司包含租赁本金的135—145全年资本支出指引写成已发生支出。[Meta Q2历史财报](https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2026/Meta-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx)、[Q3现金流及指引](https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2026/Meta-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx)
numeric_differences.english: Meta's historical Q2 figures remain useful: operating cash flow 31.862, cash PP&E purchases 30.116 and lease principal 0.962 produced FCF of +0.784. In Q3, operating cash rose 0.924 while the two payments together rose 3.828, reducing quarterly FCF by 2.904 to −2.120. Quarter-end cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled approximately 82.45. One negative quarter cannot establish an imminent payment crisis; nor can the company's full-year capital-expenditure guidance of 135—145, including lease principal, be described as spending already incurred. numeric_differences.source: Lumentum（朗美通）8月11日披露，截至6月27日的FY26Q4收入为10.063亿美元，同比增109.3%；GAAP营业利润率27.8%，非GAAP营业利润率36.6%。但同季GAAP净亏损约72亿美元，主要受约78亿美元非现金债务清偿损失影响，来自可转债股权化，而不是同额设备经营亏损或现金外流。非GAAP净利润3.263亿美元有助于观察调整后的经营，仍不能抹去债务转换对普通股股东的稀释。[Lumentum季度业绩及调节表](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1633978/000162828026055726/lite_ex991xq4fy26.htm)

Yet the same quarter's GAAP net loss was approximately USD 7.2 billion, mainly due to approximately USD 7.8 billion of noncash debt-extinguishment losses from convertible debt becoming equity, rather than an equivalent equipment operating loss or cash outflow. Non-GAAP net income of USD 326.3 million helps assess adjusted operations but cannot erase the dilution to common shareholders from debt conversion. [Lumentum quarterly results and reconciliation](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1633978/000162828026055726/lite_ex991xq4fy26.htm)

numeric_differences.source: 现金要另看完整期间：Lumentum FY2026全年经营现金流7.514亿美元、现金固定资产购置4.513亿美元，两项相减为3.001亿美元。它支持全年经营现金覆盖这项建设付款，却不是单季现金转化率，也未扣除所有投资和融资支出。这一案例提醒我们，看到巨额净亏损时先查发生在哪一层，不能直接判定需求或流动性已经崩塌。[Lumentum FY2026 10-K，现金流量表及债务附注](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1633978/000162828026057358/lite-20260627.htm)

This shows full-year operating cash covering that construction payment, not a quarterly cash-conversion ratio, and does not deduct all investing and financing expenditure. The example reminds us to locate the source of a large net loss before concluding that demand or liquidity has collapsed. FY26Q4 revenue disclosed on 12 August was USD 2.046 billion, up 33.8% on a reported basis, which must not be mixed with the company's separately reported pro forma growth rate. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 38.5% and 40.2%, with the two profit definitions separately reported. The annual report explains cash tied up in inventory and receivables and the offset from payables; NVIDIA equity funding received during the year is financing cash, not operating cash from customers buying products. Revenue demonstrates delivery; orders and higher guidance still require future performance and cannot be combined into cash already recovered. [Dell official quarterly results, pages 1—2](https://investors.delltechnologies.com/node/20956/pdf)

numeric_differences.source: 同季Dell合并经营现金流为22.25亿美元，同比下降约13%。公司现金调节表将其扣除12.39亿美元净资本支出后得到9.86亿美元FCF，再加回66.67亿美元融资应收调整及4.96亿美元经营租赁设备调整，得到81.49亿美元调整后FCF。这三个现金指标不能互换，81.49亿美元不是当季实际经营现金流。客户融资、设备交付与回款的时间差应进入研究；仅凭AI服务器收入翻倍，还无法判断客户的算力项目是否赚回资本成本。[Dell业绩现金表及FCF调节，第5、8—9页](https://investors.delltechnologies.com/node/20956/pdf)
numeric_differences.english: Dell's consolidated operating cash flow for the same quarter was USD 2.225 billion, down approximately 13% year on year. Its cash reconciliation deducts net capital expenditure of USD 1.239 billion to arrive at FCF of USD 986 million, then adds back USD 6.667 billion of financing-receivable adjustments and USD 496 million of operating-lease equipment adjustments to obtain adjusted FCF of USD 8.149 billion. These three cash metrics are not interchangeable; USD 8.149 billion is not actual quarterly operating cash flow. Timing differences among customer financing, equipment delivery and collections belong in the analysis. Doubling AI-server revenue alone cannot establish whether customers' compute projects have earned their cost of capital. [Dell cash statements and FCF reconciliation, pages 5, 8—9](https://investors.delltechnologies.com/node/20956/pdf)

All user counts, prices and consumption are research assumptions, not industry actuals.

numeric_differences.source: 第五章5.6把专业付费人月、额外按量、非专业付费月份及不重叠任务合同放入2027自然年条件模型，给出3.94B与11.66B两个演算结果。输入尚未用行业实测校准，二者不是预测区间或置信上下界。整包订阅还需分摊编程用途，托管与非编程工作不能全算入；厂商自己的API采购也不能在终端账单之外重复相加。

Inputs are not calibrated to measured industry data; these are neither a forecast range nor confidence bounds. Bundles also require coding-use allocation; hosting and noncoding work cannot all count, and vendors' own API procurement cannot be added outside end-customer bills.

numeric_differences.source: 正面证据应一并纳入。2026年发表的三项企业现场随机实验覆盖4867名开发者，合并估计完成任务数提高26.08%，标准误10.3个百分点；研究有企业与微软研究人员参与，任务和采用差异限制外推。增加任务数不是同比例工资节省，也不是最新代理的统一提效倍数。第五章5.8同时比较企业实验、维护者验收与长任务重建，5.11—5.12再把人工复核和失败补救计入同质量交付成本。[《Management Science》研究原文](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00535)。
numeric_differences.english: Positive evidence must be included. Three enterprise field randomized experiments published in 2026 covered 4867 developers, with a pooled 26.08% increase in completed tasks and a standard error of 10.3 percentage points. Company and Microsoft researchers participated; task/adoption differences limit generalization. More tasks are not proportionate wage savings or a universal productivity multiple for the latest agents. Chapter 5, 5.8 compares enterprise experiments, maintainer acceptance and long-task reconstruction; 5.11—5.12 includes human review and failure remediation in equal-quality delivery costs. [Original Management Science study](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00535).

numeric_differences.source: 第五章深化了原始劳动研究和中美成本情景：个人活动指标与公司收入、软件发布、就业数据分别使用；厂商案例、调查、自报和观察研究不冒充随机因果结论。新增证据改变的是任务与组织层面的判断，不能直接推出一个统一行业裁员率。
numeric_differences.english: Chapter 5 deepens original labor research and US/China cost scenarios, separating individual activity from company revenue, releases and employment. Vendor cases, surveys, self-reports and observational studies are not randomized causal conclusions. New evidence changes task/organization assessments, not a uniform industry layoff rate.

numeric_differences.source: 同一批释放工时不能既按工资估值，又全额计入减少外包和新增销售。假设采用不同兑现路径，应逐项重建反事实。客户保留的节省还受竞争影响：更低的软件售价或更短的服务合同可以把收益传给下游，不会全部留给IDE、模型或云厂。第五章因此分别给出产能价值、现金净收益与供应商可收费空间，避免把一张劳动成本表直接改名为TAM。
numeric_differences.english: The same released hours cannot be valued at wages and fully counted again as outsourcing savings and new sales. Different realization paths require separate counterfactuals. Competition also affects customer-retained savings: lower software prices or shorter service contracts can pass gains downstream rather than leave everything with IDE, model or cloud providers. Chapter 5 therefore separates capacity value, net cash benefits and supplier billable potential, instead of relabeling a labor-cost table TAM.

numeric_differences.source: 本轮补入的研究已经能够观察生成之后发生什么。Chen与Stratton的10月28日修订稿覆盖655家企业、累计观察720542名工作者和约4.45亿事件，发现代码产出增长大于最终交付变化，审查成为约束，整体就业未检测到显著变化。这里的“未检测到”不等于证明零替代：统计区间、采用时长及已有助手基础上的代理增量必须保留。Stanford截至6月的ADP研究则发现，22—25岁高AI暴露职业就业相对低暴露同龄人的路径落后19%，主要表现为招聘减少；作者明确将其视为描述性信号，不是AI因果裁员率。两项结果可以同时成立：某些公司尚未减员，市场入口却已收窄。[Chen–Stratton修订稿](https://fion.ac/jellyfish.pdf)、[Stanford原研究](https://digitaleconomy.stanford.edu/app/uploads/2026/08/Canaries_August2026.pdf)
numeric_differences.english: New research observes what happens after generation. Chen and Stratton's 28 October revision covers 655 firms, 720542 workers observed cumulatively and approximately 445 million events. Code-output growth exceeds final-delivery changes, review becomes a constraint, and no significant overall employment change is detected. “Not detected” does not prove zero displacement: preserve statistical intervals, adoption duration and agents' incremental effect over existing assistants. Stanford's ADP study through June finds employment trajectories for ages 22—25 in high-AI-exposure occupations lagging low-exposure peers by 19%, mainly through reduced hiring. Authors explicitly call this descriptive, not a causal AI layoff rate. Both can hold: some firms have not cut staff while market entry has narrowed. [Chen–Stratton revision](https://fion.ac/jellyfish.pdf), [Original Stanford study](https://digitaleconomy.stanford.edu/app/uploads/2026/08/Canaries_August2026.pdf)

numeric_differences.source: 第五章把这种区别落在同等验收的预算中。以下均为作者假设，包含审查、返工、治理和风险预算，不代表中美行业均值：美国10人团队稳态净释放2400小时，按原雇佣成本计值24万美元，扣工具等4万美元后为20万美元产能净值；如果全员留任且没有新增经营收益，现金及风险预算反而增加4万美元。如果确有可避免的一名全年18万美元招聘，稳态净收益才是14万美元。中国8人团队净释放900小时，按内部成本计值12万元，扣9万元后产能净值为3万元；若这些时间替代可取消的900小时、每小时220元外包，净收益为10.8万元。内部资源计值与外包节支是替代用途，不能相加。
numeric_differences.english: Chapter 5 translates this distinction into budgets with equivalent acceptance criteria. All are author assumptions, including review, rework, governance and risk budgets, not US/China industry averages. A US team of 10 releases 2400 net steady-state hours, valued at USD 240,000 using original employment costs; after USD 40,000 for tools and other items, net capacity value is USD 200,000. Retaining everyone without additional operating benefits instead increases cash/risk budget by USD 40,000. Only if a full-year USD 180,000 hire is genuinely avoidable is steady-state net benefit USD 140,000. A Chinese team of 8 releases 900 net hours valued internally at RMB 120,000; subtracting RMB 90,000 leaves net capacity value RMB 30,000. If these hours replace cancellable outsourcing of 900 hours at RMB 220/hour, net benefit is RMB 108,000. Internal resource valuation and outsourcing savings are alternative uses and cannot be added.

numeric_differences.source: 9月30日的新公告称企业占公司收入55%、ElevenAgents每周对话超过1500万；自2月以来达到原来三倍以上的是ElevenAgents ARR，并非全公司ARR。公告未给最新总ARR绝对值，不能拿不同业务与基期的0.5B去乘三，股份要约也不是客户收入。[ElevenLabs9月公告](https://elevenlabs.io/blog/tender-22bn)。
numeric_differences.english: The 30 September announcement said enterprises represented 55% of company revenue and ElevenAgents exceeded 15 million weekly conversations. The figure more than tripling since February was ElevenAgents ARR, not total company ARR. No latest absolute company ARR was supplied; 0.5B from another scope/base period cannot be multiplied by three. A tender offer is not customer revenue. [ElevenLabs September announcement](https://elevenlabs.io/blog/tender-22bn).

numeric_differences.source: AI视频短剧的中美比较和模型厂商分析见第四章。短剧对模型的需求来自生产链：正片生成、失败重试、角色与镜头迭代、投流素材、本地化和音频。成片被更多观众播放，首先增加的是内容和分发活动，不是模型按相同人数重新生成；若没有新增作品或实时个性化生成，观看分钟数不能直接乘成API市场。
numeric_differences.english: See Chapter 4 for US/China AI-video microdrama comparisons and model-provider analysis. Model demand comes from production: finished footage, failed retries, character/shot iteration, acquisition creatives, localization and audio. More viewers watching finished content chiefly increases content/distribution activity, not regeneration for every viewer. Without new titles or real-time personalized generation, viewing minutes cannot directly multiply into an API market.

numeric_differences.source: Seedance、MiniMax／海螺、可灵等也不应归为同一种公司生意。模型API、消费者创作订阅、开放权重自部署、平台内部调用和发行渠道，各有不同的付款方及利润归属。更好的可用率可能减少同一部剧的付费尝试，又允许工作室制作更多作品；降价、良率与产量的合成效果，才决定模型收入。第四章用具名产品和公司财务约束这条推导，区分对视频生成、配音及文本策划模型的不同影响。
numeric_differences.english: Seedance, MiniMax/Hailuo and Kling should not be treated as the same business. APIs, consumer creation subscriptions, self-hosted open weights, internal platform usage and distribution channels have different payers and profit attribution. Better usable-output rates may reduce paid attempts per drama while enabling more titles. Price cuts, yield and output jointly determine model revenue. Chapter 4 constrains this reasoning with named products and financials, separating effects on video, dubbing and text-planning models.

numeric_differences.source: 财务已经支持更具体的判断。MiniMax2026上半年集团收入1.16573亿美元、毛利2081.3万美元，研发开支2.96870亿美元；开放平台及企业服务占收入63.4%，并未拆出视频和短剧贡献。2025年前九个月海螺产品收入1746.4万美元证明视频存在真实收费，但不能沿用其历史占比解释今天的集团增长。可灵上半年两个季度收入分别超过6.5亿元、8.5亿元人民币，也不能据此填出独立视频净利润。它们增强了应用需求证据，却没有消除研发回收问题。[MiniMax中期业绩](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0826/2026082600680.pdf)、[MiniMax招股书](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/1231/2025123100025.pdf)、[快手Q1业绩](https://ir.kuaishou.com/node/11461/pdf)、[快手Q2业绩](https://ir.kuaishou.com/zh-hans/news-releases/news-release-details/kuaishoukejifabu2026niandierjidujizhongqiweijingshenhecaiwuyeji)
numeric_differences.english: Financials support a more specific assessment. MiniMax 2026 first-half group revenue was USD 116.573 million, gross profit USD 20.813 million and R&D USD 296.870 million. Open platform/enterprise services represented 63.4%, without a video/microdrama breakdown. Hailuo product revenue of USD 17.464 million in the first nine months of 2025 proves real video billing, but its historical share cannot explain today's group growth. Kling revenue exceeded RMB 650 million and RMB 850 million in the two first-half quarters, but cannot supply standalone video net income. These strengthen application-demand evidence without resolving R&D recovery. [MiniMax interim results](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0826/2026082600680.pdf), [MiniMax prospectus](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/1231/2025123100025.pdf), [Kuaishou Q1 results](https://ir.kuaishou.com/node/11461/pdf), [Kuaishou Q2 results](https://ir.kuaishou.com/zh-hans/news-releases/news-release-details/kuaishoukejifabu2026niandierjidujizhongqiweijingshenhecaiwuyeji)

numeric_differences.source: 第四章另以120分钟成片说明传导尺度：在明确假设AI比例、复用、广告与本地化之后，新增采用6000秒、采用率25%、90%收费，按H3官方768p输出每秒0.08美元，限定输出费为1728美元。它不含另行输入、高清及服务项目，也不是实际剧目预算。若同规格价格减半、采用率翻倍，新采用产量要增至原来四倍才能保持输出收入；算力与贡献利润又有各自阈值。这比“短剧观看超过电影，因此模型收入爆发”的推论更接近可检验的商业问题。[H3现行计费项目](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview)
numeric_differences.english: Chapter 4 also illustrates transmission using 120 minutes of finished footage. With explicit AI share, reuse, advertising/localization assumptions, newly accepted output of 6000 seconds, acceptance yield 25% and 90% charged, H3's official 768p output rate of USD 0.08/second gives restricted output fees of USD 1728. This excludes separate input, high-definition and service charges and is not an actual title budget. If same-specification prices halve and acceptance yield doubles, newly accepted output must quadruple to maintain output revenue; compute and contribution profit have separate thresholds. This is more testable than “microdrama viewing exceeds movies, so model revenue explodes.” [Current H3 billing items](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview)

numeric_differences.source: V1.8补入的财报已经能区分具体模式，而不必统称“尚无商业化”。Duolingo Q2收入0.298454B、公司定义FCF为0.078630B，证明完整教育产品可以产生现金，但不能拆成AI功能净贡献。Tempus同期收入0.382486B，营业亏损0.075913B而净利润0.005642B，包含0.0985B证券未实现收益；净利润转正不能独立证明医疗AI经营盈利。Pony.ai Q2 Robotaxi服务收入约0.0121B，含联合部署相关收入，不全是乘客车费；同期集团仍经营亏损。三例均按自身业务口径使用，不合计为一个AI应用市场。[Duolingo Q2 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1562088/000162828026053603/duol-20260630.htm)、[Tempus Q2财报](https://investors.tempus.com/files/doc_news/2026/07/Tempus-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Results.pdf)、[Pony.ai Q2财报](https://ir.pony.ai/news-releases/news-release-details/pony-ai-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-total)。完整成本、数据期间与反方解释见第六章6.7—6.9。
numeric_differences.english: Financial reports added in V1.8 distinguish business models rather than label them all “not commercialized.” Duolingo Q2 revenue of 0.298454B and company FCF of 0.078630B show a complete education product generating cash, not isolated AI-feature contribution. Tempus revenue was 0.382486B, operating loss 0.075913B and net income 0.005642B, including unrealized securities gains of 0.0985B. Positive net income alone does not establish profitable healthcare-AI operations. Pony.ai Q2 Robotaxi service revenue of approximately 0.0121B includes joint-deployment revenue, not only fares; the group still had an operating loss. Use each on its own scope, without summing an AI-application market. [Duolingo Q2 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1562088/000162828026053603/duol-20260630.htm), [Tempus Q2 earnings](https://investors.tempus.com/files/doc_news/2026/07/Tempus-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Results.pdf), [Pony.ai Q2 earnings](https://ir.pony.ai/news-releases/news-release-details/pony-ai-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-total). See Chapter 6, 6.7—6.9 for full costs, periods and counterinterpretations.

numeric_differences.source: 政府收费同样需要区别名义预算和消费。Anthropic10月27日宣布对政府客户的Enterprise、Government及API给出40%折扣，直采立即适用，云渠道在随后数月推进；公司明确没有最低消费承诺。约500家政府组织使用及估计节省10亿美元均为公司披露，后者不是10亿美元订单。折扣可能促进采用，也会降低同等用量下的收入，只有后续使用、续购和成本能判断净效果。[Anthropic—GSA协议说明](https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-partnership-gsa)
numeric_differences.english: Government billing likewise distinguishes nominal budgets from consumption. On 27 October Anthropic announced 40% discounts on Enterprise, Government and API for government customers, immediately for direct procurement and over subsequent months for cloud channels, explicitly without minimum spending commitments. Approximately 500 government organizations using it and estimated savings of USD 1 billion are company disclosures; the latter is not USD 1 billion of orders. Discounts may encourage adoption while lowering revenue for equal use; subsequent usage, renewals and costs determine net effects. [Anthropic—GSA agreement explanation](https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-partnership-gsa)

numeric_differences.source: Character.ai于10月12日进入自愿Chapter 11法院监督出售程序，当时服务继续运行，不等于已经停服或出售完成。法院CEO证词披露8月收入约530万美元、净现金消耗约820万美元，并说明法律、人员与融资压力；不能单独归因为算力成本，更不能外推所有陪伴产品失败。这个案例使研究必须同时检查收入、完整服务成本和融资依赖。[官方公告](https://blog.character.ai/an-update-on-character-ai/)、[法院Doc 18，第4—5、11—12页](https://cases.stretto.com/public/x936/14939/PLEADINGS/1493910132680000000119.pdf)。
numeric_differences.english: Character.ai entered a voluntary Chapter 11 court-supervised sale process on 12 October, with services continuing then, not already shut down or sold. The CEO's court declaration disclosed approximately USD 5.3 million August revenue and USD 8.2 million net cash burn, citing legal, staffing and financing pressures. Compute cost alone cannot explain this, nor can it establish failure of all companionship products. This case requires examining revenue, full service costs and financing dependence together. [Official announcement](https://blog.character.ai/an-update-on-character-ai/), [Court Doc 18, pages 4—5, 11—12](https://cases.stretto.com/public/x936/14939/PLEADINGS/1493910132680000000119.pdf).

numeric_differences.source: 中国也应按业务边界判断。百度Q2公司内部管理口径AI Applications收入25亿元、AI原生营销收入26亿元，分别同比+3%和基本持平；阿里6月季报新设AI Labs and Applications分部收入33.38亿元、调整后EBITA亏损138.61亿元，包含模型实验室及应用，不能全算成某个消费者App的亏损。前者表明具名AI收费已经存在，后者表明混合业务仍需资金支持，均不是中国AI应用全行业利润结论。[百度Q2财报及脚注](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1329099/000119312526355431/d112854dex991.htm)、[阿里6月季报](https://data.alibabagroup.com/ecms-files/1532295521/fa5d65fc-9b3e-4e82-a8fc-4ce1c3e2c407/Alibaba%20Group%20Announces%20June%20Quarter%202026%20Results.pdf)。
numeric_differences.english: China also requires business boundaries. Baidu's internal-management Q2 AI Applications revenue was RMB 2.5 billion and AI-native marketing RMB 2.6 billion, respectively +3% year on year and broadly flat. Alibaba's new AI Labs and Applications segment in the June-quarter report had revenue RMB 3.338 billion and adjusted EBITA loss RMB 13.861 billion, including model labs and apps, not entirely one consumer app's losses. The former establishes named AI billing; the latter shows mixed businesses still needing funding. Neither defines China-wide AI-application profits. [Baidu Q2 earnings and footnotes](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1329099/000119312526355431/d112854dex991.htm), [Alibaba June-quarter report](https://data.alibabagroup.com/ecms-files/1532295521/fa5d65fc-9b3e-4e82-a8fc-4ce1c3e2c407/Alibaba%20Group%20Announces%20June%20Quarter%202026%20Results.pdf).

numeric_differences.source: 若一批请求全部满足相应上下文条件，共有100万未缓存输入、20万计费输出token，按表中费率，Sol账单为4美元，Luna为0.20美元，Opus 5.5为8美元；GPT-6.1 Sol与Sonnet 5.5同为4美元。这只是固定用量账单。实际任务可能消耗不同token数，重试、工具及人工复核也不同，不能按账单比例认定真实交付成本同比例下降。
numeric_differences.english: For requests all meeting their context conditions, 1 million uncached input and 200,000 billed output tokens cost USD 4 for Sol, USD 0.20 for Luna and USD 8 for Opus 5.5; GPT-6.1 Sol and Sonnet 5.5 both cost USD 4. This is a fixed-usage bill. Real tasks may use different token counts, retries, tools and human review; proportional bills do not establish proportional changes in actual delivery cost.

numeric_differences.source: Haiku的门槛按每条请求判断，提示输入包括缓存读写输入，而不是只对超过10万的部分加价。若10条请求各含10万未缓存输入、2万输出，合计100万输入、20万输出，账单为0.20美元；若同样总量拆成5条各20万输入、4万输出的请求，每条进入高档，合计就是1美元。总token相同，分档后的费用并不相同。
numeric_differences.english: Haiku thresholds apply per request; prompt input includes cached read/write input, and the premium is not only on tokens above 100,000. Ten requests each with 100,000 uncached input and 20,000 output total 1 million input/200,000 output and cost USD 0.20. Splitting the same total into five requests each with 200,000 input/40,000 output puts every request in the high tier, totaling USD 1. Equal total tokens do not mean equal tiered charges.

numeric_differences.source: 以下是按Fable5.1公开价构造的例题，流量不是实际客户数据：未缓存输入100万token、缓存读取1000万token、输出20万token，则三项费用分别为10美元、2.5美元和10美元，合计22.5美元。若只将缓存读取价换成上一代的1美元、其余条件保持不变，则为30美元，账单下降25%，不是75%。
numeric_differences.english: This example uses public Fable5.1 prices, not actual customer traffic: 1 million uncached input, 10 million cached-read and 200,000 output tokens cost USD 10, USD 2.5 and USD 10, totaling USD 22.5. Replacing only cache-read pricing with the previous generation's USD 1, everything else unchanged, gives USD 30: a 25% bill reduction, not 75%.

numeric_differences.source: 先看一组假设，不把它冒充任何公司的盈利预测：10万个付费用户，每人每月平均实际付款30美元，月收入为300万美元；月推理与托管成本120万美元，另有60万美元交付成本，包括支持、内容许可和支付费用，则毛利120万美元、毛利率40%。这还没有减研发、销售、管理、利息和税，不能叫净利润率。
numeric_differences.english: Start with assumptions, not any company's earnings forecast: 100,000 paying users averaging USD 30 monthly generate USD 3 million revenue. Monthly inference/hosting costs USD 1.2 million, plus USD 600,000 delivery costs including support, content licenses and payment fees, leave USD 1.2 million gross profit and 40% gross margin. R&D, sales, administration, interest and tax are not deducted, so this is not net margin.

numeric_differences.source: 若推理与托管单价降30%、总用量增20%，这项成本由120万美元变为100.8万美元；收入与其他交付成本暂时不变时，毛利变为139.2万美元、毛利率46.4%。因此上游API价格下降不必导致下游应用毛利下降。若竞争又迫使应用售价降20%，月收入变为240万美元，同样成本下毛利率则仅33.0%。最后结果取决于节约由用户、应用商还是模型商拿走。
numeric_differences.english: If inference/hosting unit prices fall 30% and total usage rises 20%, that cost falls from USD 1.2 million to USD 1.008 million. With revenue and other delivery costs unchanged, gross profit becomes USD 1.392 million and gross margin 46.4%. Upstream API cuts therefore need not reduce application gross margins. If competition also cuts application selling prices 20%, monthly revenue falls to USD 2.4 million and the same costs leave only 33.0% gross margin. Outcomes depend on whether users, application vendors or model providers retain savings.

numeric_differences.source: 本轮没有将媒体转述的“国内短剧加漫剧1210亿元”“AI短剧400亿元”等预测纳入核心市场规模计算。一些材料把内容收入、广告交易、制作服务和模型服务分别列为市场，但这些钱可能沿同一条价值链流动。即使某个预测最终准确，制作方付给模型商的钱，也不能再与终端内容收入相加，冒充新增消费者需求。当前证据不足以给中美AI主生成短剧各自一个可靠的总收入、利润率和市场份额。
numeric_differences.english: This review excludes media-reported forecasts such as “RMB 121 billion for domestic microdramas plus animated microdramas” and “RMB 40 billion for AI microdramas” from its core market-sizing calculations. Some materials list content revenue, advertising transactions, production services, and model services as separate markets, although the same money may flow along one value chain. Even if a forecast ultimately proves accurate, producers' payments to model vendors cannot be added again to end-market content revenue and presented as additional consumer demand. Current evidence cannot support reliable separate estimates of total revenue, profit margins, and market share for primarily AI-generated microdramas in China and the United States.

numeric_differences.source: 兑吧提供了更直接的收入证据。其2026年中期报告单列AI短剧收入2.22629亿元，占集团收入约51.2%；集团同期仍有2532.6万元亏损。报告只设一个可报告经营分部，不能从集团损益倒推出AI短剧的独立净利率。10月14日的港交所公告进一步称，根据未经审核管理账目的初步评估，预期AI短剧业务在7、8、9月连续单月录得纯利，但没有披露利润金额，并明确未经核数师审核或审阅。这是积极的经营信号，其证明强度仍低于经核验、可连续比较的分部利润和现金流。[兑吧中期报告](https://yun.duiba.com.cn/corp/report/content/1/2026%E4%B8%AD%E6%9C%9F%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A.3f87c290d81d43e1b87da58f7eaf9818.pdf)、[兑吧10月14日正式公告](https://www.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/1014/2026101400004_c.pdf)
numeric_differences.english: Duiba supplies more direct revenue evidence. Its 2026 interim report separately discloses RMB 222.629 million of AI microdrama revenue, approximately 51.2% of group revenue, while the group still reported a loss of RMB 25.326 million for the same period. The report has only one reportable operating segment, so a standalone AI microdrama net margin cannot be reverse-engineered from group earnings. Its 14 October Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement further stated that a preliminary assessment of unaudited management accounts indicated that the AI microdrama business was expected to record a net profit in each of July, August, and September. It did not disclose profit amounts and explicitly said the figures had not been audited or reviewed by the auditor. This is a positive operating signal, but weaker evidence than verified segment profits and cash flows that can be compared consistently over time. [Duiba interim report](https://yun.duiba.com.cn/corp/report/content/1/2026%E4%B8%AD%E6%9C%9F%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A.3f87c290d81d43e1b87da58f7eaf9818.pdf), [Duiba official announcement of 14 October](https://www.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/1014/2026101400004_c.pdf)

numeric_differences.source: 中文在线则说明，生产降本与上市公司盈利不能合并判断。其上半年短剧及IP衍生品业务收入为4.11260亿元，但该类别包含不同内容与衍生业务，不是AI收入。10月26日披露的三季报把营业成本下降的重要原因归于部分海外短剧转为AI制作，同时披露前三季度集团收入8.32732亿元、归母净亏损1.32051亿元，经营现金净流入4279.60万元。AI应用、成本下降、整体亏损可以同时存在。[中文在线2026半年报，第22页](https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-08-26/1225504423.PDF)、[中文在线2026三季报，第2—4页](https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-10-26/1225620142.PDF)
numeric_differences.english: COL illustrates why production cost savings and listed-company profitability must be assessed separately. Its first-half revenue from microdramas and IP derivatives was RMB 411.260 million, but that category contains different content and derivative businesses and is not AI revenue. The third-quarter report disclosed on 26 October attributed an important part of the decrease in operating costs to some overseas microdramas switching to AI production. It also reported group revenue of RMB 832.732 million, a net loss attributable to parent-company shareholders of RMB 132.051 million, and net operating cash inflow of RMB 42.7960 million for the first three quarters. Creating a PR is not the same as merging production code, and all of GitHub is not the Copilot paying population. Older media reports on the latter still use 718 enterprises, approximately 300 million events, and earlier coefficients; this chapter does not mix old samples with new results. numeric_differences.source: 以下案例因此使用独立、明确的作者假设：美国每人每年18万美元现金雇佣成本，中国每人每年24万元人民币；均含工资及假设的雇主附加支出，不含办公室租约、长期管理层固定费用与股权薪酬。中国例可理解为18万元工资加6万元雇主相关成本，美国例也不声称是BLS的软件职业均值。两者都用1800小时年度可配置劳动容量，包含需求、沟通、审查、运维等，不是1800小时纯写代码。1800是排班假设，须由客户实际假期、培训、会议与值班记录替换。
numeric_differences.english: The following examples therefore use explicit, independent author assumptions: annual cash employment cost of USD 180000 per US employee and RMB 240000 per Chinese employee. Both include wages and assumed additional employer expenses, excluding office leases, long-term fixed management costs, and equity compensation. The Chinese example can be read as RMB 180000 of wages plus RMB 60000 of employer-related costs; the US example does not claim to be the BLS software-occupation average. Both use 1800 hours of allocable annual labor capacity, including requirements, communication, review, and operations—not 1800 hours purely writing code. The 1800 is a scheduling assumption to be replaced by actual customer records for leave, training, meetings, and on-call work.

numeric_differences.source: 软件劳动成本池大，说明技术具有经济重要性，却不是工具商收入。要把它变成可支付预算，必须扣除不能自动化的工作、未采用的团队、复核返工、没有兑现的时间，并让客户保留足够收益。旧稿“5000亿美元以上软件开发价值池”没有在本轮重新核定为当前全球统计；不能用它绕开国家、职业和会计边界，代替已撤回的席位上限。
numeric_differences.english: A large software-labor cost pool establishes economic significance, not tool-vendor revenue. Converting it into a payable budget requires deductions for work that cannot be automated, teams that do not adopt, review and rework, and time not realized as savings, while leaving customers sufficient benefit. The old draft's “software-development value pool above USD 500 billion” has not been reverified here as current global statistics. It cannot bypass national, occupational, and accounting boundaries to replace the withdrawn seat ceiling.

numeric_differences.source: 现金兑现至少有三条互斥路径。保留全部10人、没有新收入且不撤任何采购，稳态现金/风险预算变化是−40000美元，首年−60000美元；200000美元是可使用的产能净值，不是已赚利润。如果确实有已批准的同类岗位需求，能把一名全年18万美元的招聘避免，且释放时间和技能能覆盖1800小时，稳态净收益为140000美元，余下600小时另作缓冲。首年只有1500小时净释放，不能据此避免一个完整人年的必要工作；若排班允许延后半年招聘，避免支付90000美元，扣60000美元首年成本后为30000美元。招聘基线应在上线前登记，不能事后虚构。
numeric_differences.english: There are at least three mutually exclusive cash-realization paths. Retaining all 10 people, with no new revenue and no canceled procurement, changes the steady-state cash/risk budget by −USD 40000 and the first-year budget by −USD 60000. USD 200000 is usable net capacity value, not profit already earned. If there is an approved need for a comparable role, one full-year USD 180000 hire can truly be avoided, and released time and skills cover 1800 hours, steady-state net benefit is USD 140000, with the remaining 600 hours as a buffer. First-year net release is only 1500 hours, insufficient to avoid a full person-year of necessary work. If scheduling allows a half-year hiring delay, USD 90000 of payments can be avoided, leaving USD 30000 after first-year costs of USD 60000. Register the hiring baseline before deployment; do not invent it afterward.

numeric_differences.source: 中国例更接近一道采购边界题。900小时按内部成本只值12万元，扣9万元支出与风险预算后只剩3万元；首年学习接入吞掉7.2万元机会成本，加3万元外部接入，产能净值转负。即使全年没有发生裁员，这项工具也可能有效；但管理者必须说明会如何用好仅有的900小时，否则只有预算增加。0.5人年不能直接从8人变成7.5人，更不能四舍五入裁一人。
numeric_differences.english: The Chinese example is closer to a procurement boundary case. At internal cost, 900 hours are worth only RMB 120000, leaving RMB 30000 after RMB 90000 of spending and risk budget. First-year learning and integration consume RMB 72000 of opportunity cost; adding RMB 30000 of external integration turns net capacity value negative. The tool may be effective without any layoffs during the year, but managers must explain how they will use the mere 900 hours productively; otherwise the budget only increases. 0.5 person-years does not directly turn 8 people into 7.5, much less justify rounding up to dismiss one person.

numeric_differences.source: 外包迁移尤其值得单列。原来客户向服务商付100万元项目费，服务商用70万元人力完成；应用AI后人力变50万元、模型和治理新增10万元，如果合同仍收100万元，服务商毛利多10万元。续约时客户要求降到85万元，则客户拿15万元，服务商毛利反而比原来少5万元。70、50、10、85均是假设，用来说明生产率增长怎样与服务商利润下降同时成立。真正应跟踪的是同等验收项目报价、可计费人数/工时、实现毛利与续约，而不是只看服务商宣布培训了多少员工。
numeric_differences.english: Outsourcing migration particularly deserves separate treatment. Suppose a customer originally pays RMB 1 million for a project and the provider completes it with RMB 700000 of labor. With AI, labor falls to RMB 500000 and models/governance add RMB 100000. If the contract still pays RMB 1 million, provider gross profit rises RMB 100000. If renewal brings a customer demand for RMB 850000, the customer gains RMB 150000 while provider gross profit falls RMB 50000 below its original level. The 700000, 500000, 100000, and 850000 are all assumptions illustrating how productivity growth and declining provider profit can coexist. Track project quotations at equal acceptance standards, billable people/hours, realized gross profit, and renewals—not just announced numbers of employees trained.

numeric_differences.source: **资料截止：2026年10月31日，北京时间。** 本专题沿用V1.8已核的非编程、非视频应用证据；V1.9深化的视频模型与软件劳动研究分别见第四章、第五章，不将本专题每家公司冒称本轮重新取证。这里的“AI应用”包括在原有软件、信息服务和实体运营中增加AI的业务，也包括以AI为核心的新产品。两者都可能创造价值，但不能合并称为生成式AI新增收入。
numeric_differences.english: **Information cutoff: 31 October 2026, Beijing time.** This chapter retains the noncoding, nonvideo application evidence verified in V1.8. V1.9's deeper research on video models and software labor appears in Chapters 4 and 5 respectively; this chapter does not claim that every company here was researched afresh in this round. “AI applications” includes AI added to existing software, information services, and physical operations, as well as new products built around AI. Both can create value, but they cannot collectively be called incremental generative-AI revenue.

numeric_differences.source: 对第三章原有十四领域框架，本轮作三项更新：**补齐部分领域的可核收费及现金数据；把订阅、广告和实体服务的资金回收路径分别建账；把高使用量而无法持续运营的反例纳入正文。** 不把应用市场的方向性进展直接换成一个全球收入总数，也不借此判定所有AI基础设施投资都能收回。若任何市场估计把全部办公薪资、广告支出、医疗支出或汽车出行支出视为供应商可以取得的AI收入，分母仍然过大。
numeric_differences.english: This review makes three updates to Chapter 3's original fourteen-field framework: **add verifiable billing and cash data for some fields; account separately for the cash-recovery paths of subscriptions, advertising, and physical services; and include cases of heavy usage without sustainable operations in the main text.** Directional application-market progress is not converted into a global revenue total or used to conclude that all AI infrastructure investment will be recovered. Any market estimate treating all office payroll, advertising spending, medical expenditure, or automotive travel spending as AI revenue available to suppliers still uses too broad a denominator.

numeric_differences.source: **可复算的客户现金ROI假设。** 假设一家企业1000名员工，每人每月节省4小时作业时间，此数尚未扣除下列复核返工，全年48000小时；可归属人工成本每小时50美元，则“时间价值”为240万美元。假设只有25%的时间能兑现为减少加班、外包或避免新增招聘，现金收益为60万美元；年订阅36万美元、接入治理15万美元、复核返工12万美元，总成本63万美元，年度现金净收益为−3万美元。若其他条件不变，现金兑现比例达到26.25%才保本；达到50%时净收益57万美元。这些均是纯假设，不是M365客户均值，也没有把员工时间直接等同于裁员收益。若节省的时间变成新增销售，应计新增贡献毛利并避免再次计入同一批节省工时。
numeric_differences.english: **A reproducible hypothetical customer cash ROI.** Assume an enterprise has 1000 employees, each saving 4 task hours per month before the review/rework costs below: 48000 hours annually. At attributable labor cost of USD 50/hour, “time value” is USD 2.4 million. Assume only 25% can become reduced overtime, outsourcing, or avoided new hires, giving USD 600000 of cash benefit. Annual subscriptions of USD 360000, integration/governance of USD 150000, and review/rework of USD 120000 total USD 630000, leaving annual net cash benefit of −USD 30000. With other conditions unchanged, cash realization must reach 26.25% to break even; at 50%, net benefit is USD 570000. These are purely hypothetical, not M365 customer averages, and do not equate employee time directly with layoff benefits. If saved time produces new sales, count incremental contribution profit and avoid counting the same hours again as savings.

numeric_differences.source: 本轮深化进一步区分了应用需求与价值捕获。短剧生产会购买视频、语音和文本策划能力，同一成片可反复播放，生成成本可由多次消费摊薄，不按播放次数重复生成。模型厂商的净收入取决于新增生产量、采购入口、免费或捆绑额度、采用率与净单价；更少返工有利于工作室，却可能减少同量内容的API账单。若新作品和广告素材需求扩张足够快，总调用又可能增加。第四章将这些方向放在同一套量价与成本模型中，既不预设降价必毁收入，也不预设所有内容消费都变成模型利润。
numeric_differences.english: This round's deeper analysis further distinguishes application demand from value capture. Microdrama production purchases video, voice and text-planning capabilities. The same finished title can be viewed repeatedly, spreading generation costs across multiple consumption events without generating it again for each viewing. Model providers' net revenue depends on incremental production volume, purchasing channel, free or bundled credits, adoption and net unit price. Less rework helps studios but may reduce the API bill for the same amount of content; sufficiently rapid growth in new works and advertising assets may increase total calls again. Chapter 4 puts these directions in one volume, price and cost model, presuming neither that price cuts must destroy revenue nor that all content consumption becomes model-provider profit.

numeric_differences.source: AI编程对人力的影响也会双向传导。合格交付成本降低，可能扩大企业愿意购买的代理任务，减少部分招聘、外包或既有岗位；也可能让原团队承接更多项目。工资现金只有在具体兑现路径发生时才减少，工具、治理、复核和过渡费用则可能先发生。对资本市场，客户端ROI改善既可以支持工具收入，也可能压低软件与服务价格、减少传统席位；模型和云能拿到多少收益，需要从合同与竞争重新核验。第五章把观察到的组织研究、条件成本模型与全行业替代率的未知分开。
numeric_differences.english: AI coding's labor effects also transmit in both directions. Lower qualified-delivery costs may expand the agent tasks companies are willing to buy, reduce some hiring, outsourcing or existing jobs, or allow the original team to take on more projects. Payroll cash falls only when a specific realization path occurs, while tool, governance, review and transition costs may arise first. For capital markets, improved customer ROI can support tool revenue while also lowering software and service prices and reducing traditional seats. How much model and cloud providers capture must be reverified through contracts and competition. Chapter 5 separates observed organizational research, conditional cost models and unknown industry-wide substitution rates.
